message: When the lights go out, I like to embrace the moment and turn it into a cozy event! A headlamp and a stack of playing cards make for the perfect night in. It’s amazing how a little creativity can turn a power outage into a fun adventure. What’s your go-to way to keep the good vibes going during a blackout? ✨
